name: app-lavender-project-result-stepped-percent-bars-slide
title: Project Result with Stepped Percent Bars
whatItIs: A lavender slide with 'Project Result', a headline about a seamless travel booking experience, a giant faint quote mark, a founder avatar and three blue gradient bars with angled shoulders and percentages 52, 61 and 45 with captions.
whatItMeans: The stepped bars turn results into a bold graphic skyline, and captions sit beside each for clarity.
techniques: Bars with an angled shoulder as a stylised bar chart
Percentages placed at the top of each bar
Captions placed beside the bars at alternating heights
Giant faint quote mark as decoration
Blue gradient fading light to dark

vocabulary.definition: A bar chart element given a custom, graphic shape.
A short heading and sentence explaining a number.
A huge faint quotation mark used as decoration.
